title: microsorum ithycarpum
intro: Microsorum ithycarpum, commonly known as the 'Mangrove Fern', is a type of plant species that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, which can help in soothing wounds, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum ithycarpum include its ability to inhibit bacterial growth, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
